answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the echo is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
